business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Cryogenic Pumps

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (République française) - single national jurisdiction without sub-state company-law distinction
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code) with strong European Union regulatory overlay
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–PRC Agreement on the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (1984, as supplemented)
France–Hong Kong SAR Promotion and Protection of Investments Agreement (1996)
Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) between Canada and the EU (provisionally in force since 21 September 2017)
Over 120 double taxation avoidance agreements maintained by France, including with the United States (1994), China (1984, as amended), and India (1992)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, in particular arts. L. 561-2-2, L. 561-45 to L. 561-49 and R. 561-1 et seq. (beneficial-owner identification and declaration); Code de commerce arts. L. 223-1, L. 123-1 to L. 123-11-1 and R. 123-30 (RCS registration, registered office and public filings); Directive (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5) and Regulation (EU) 2024/2889 (harmonised beneficial-ownership transparency framework); TRACFIN and ACPR supervisory guidance on AML/CFT risk management.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the ultimate beneficial owner's passport (identity page), with French or English translation if necessary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority in the UBO's country of nationality, or a registered notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the origin territory is a party to the 1961 Hague Convention; otherwise French Consular Legalization plus certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good conduct / extract of criminal record for the proposed SARL manager (gérant)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National criminal-records authority in the manager's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or French Consular Legalization; certified French translation required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of the UBO and manager, such as a utility bill or bank certificate dated within three months
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Municipal authority, public utility provider, or bank where the holder holds an account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized certification plus Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for foreign documents; certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and good standing of any corporate shareholder that will hold the SARL capital, including upstream ownership documentation for UBO piercing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or court clerk in the parent company's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or French Consular Legalization; official French translation by a sworn translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft articles of association (statuts) of the SARL in French, signed by all shareholders and the manager for registration purposes
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French lawyer or French notary (notaire) if notarization is elected
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: French notarial deed when notarized; for private-practice articles, signatures authenticated by the RCS registrar upon filing; no apostille applies to original French documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, managers and material shareholders against TRACFIN asset-freeze files, EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, UN Security Council sanctions lists, and OFAC lists when USD clearing or US nexus exists. PEP identification under art. L. 561-2-2 includes domestic and foreign politically exposed persons plus their family members and known close associates. Enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, source-of-wealth documentation and source-of-funds verification are required for PEPs and higher-risk counterparties. Negative news screening and corporate-structure justification are documented in the AML file, which must be retained for at least five years after the termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (pro.guichet-entreprises.fr); company-name collision search via Greffe du tribunal de commerce / RCS records; trademark pre-clearance via the INPI national trade-mark database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory filings and the corporate name must be in French. A foreign-language name is accepted if rendered in Latin characters, not contrary to public order, not misleading, and sufficiently distinctive. If the proposed name uses non-Latin script, a Latin-character transliteration is mandatory for insertion in the RCS. The name must be capable of being pronounced or written in French and must be followed by the legal form SARL or société à responsabilité limitée.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: French law does not provide a standalone statutory company-name reservation prior to formation; the pre-filing name-clearance report and trademark pre-search certificate are therefore treated as valid for a best-practice 30-day window. If the INPI/RCS filing is rejected on name-conflict or inadmissibility grounds, the declarant is notified through the Guichet unique and may correct and resubmit the declaration without incurring a second set of registration formalities unless a third-party opposition has been recorded. In case of formal refusal by the RCS registrar, the applicant may petition the President of the competent Tribunal judiciaire under RCS rectification rules (see art. R. 123-90 et seq. Code de commerce). The applicant must provide a revised French-language set of articles of association and clearly exclude the conflicting token or company name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for the administrative seat only: a SARL may be domiciled with a licensed commercial domiciliation company under art. L. 123-11-1 Code de commerce for a limited statutory period. For a licensed manufacturer of LNG cryogenic pumps, a virtual office alone is not sufficient: the company must maintain a genuine industrial establishment in France, comply with the French environmental regime applicable to classified facilities (ICPE), satisfy pressure-equipment and technical safety regulations, and maintain substantive presence, payroll and decision-making records in France for AML and tax-substance purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High – approximately 70% likelihood of unannounced on-site physical inspection within the first 24 months of operation by DREAL (environment), DRIEETS (labour), customs and technical safety authorities due to the industrial cryogenic-process profile, licensed activity requirements, and export-control sensitivity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence, corporate governance design, UBO identification and entity-structure memorandum by a French bar-regulated attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French law firm / avocat admitted to a French bar
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: fixed fee per stage using blended hourly rate of EUR 280–420

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO, PEP and sanctions screening using global watchlist databases, corporate-chain verification and negative-news checks for all identified natural persons
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance technology provider or French audit/compliance firm under GDPR and TRACFIN guidance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per screened entity and per screened individual

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI company-name and trademark pre-availability search, including a prior-rights search report from a French industrial-property attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI and/or licensed French IP attorney (CPI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory INPI filing fees plus professional search fee; 2024 official fee schedule and prevailing market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Guichet unique formalities, RCS registration and mandatory legal-announcement publication in an authorized legal newspaper (journal d'annonces légales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI, Greffe du Tribunal de commerce, and authorized legal-announcement journal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory greffe tariff (approximately EUR 320) plus regulated announcement publication cost (approximately EUR 150–180)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille or consular legalization of four foreign-origin documents (passport, criminal-record certificate, address proof, parent-company extract)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, French consulate, or competent apostille authority in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document apostille fee plus notarial certification tariff; estimated for four originals and four sworn copies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translation of all non-French documents submitted to the Guichet unique
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator certified by a French court of appeal (traducteur assermenté)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing official translator tariff of approximately EUR 60–90 per page plus certification

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial domiciliation agreement for the first year, including registered-office address and administrative mail handling
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered commercial domiciliation company (société de domiciliation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of EUR 25–50 per month for the first bankable address

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency reserve for additional certified translations, urgent amendments, statutory fees, or supplemental registry formalities during name clearance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French law firm, notary, INPI, or Greffe du Tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Cost-plus estimate of residual statutory and professional fees

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.210-6, L.223-1 to L.223-66 (SARL regime), L.123-36 and R.123-83 et seq. (registration in the Registre National des Entreprises); Law No. 2019-486 (PACTE); Décret No. 2022-1015 (Guichet unique); Code de l'environnement, L.511-1 et seq. for ICPE matters where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce within the territorial jurisdiction of the registered office, and INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle) as operator of the Guichet unique and registrar of the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Formulaire M0 / CERFA 11661*02 – Déclaration de création d'une société à responsabilité limitée, transmitted electronically through the INPI Guichet unique (formalities.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital for a SARL; the partners freely fix the share capital in the Articles of Association. Cash contributions must be deposited and blocked with a bank, a notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations before filing and cannot be withdrawn until the company is registered. In-kind contributions must be fully paid up at signature of the Articles; if the value exceeds EUR 30,000 or comprises real property, a commissaire aux apports report is mandatory unless an exemption under Article L.223-9 applies. For the proposed cryogenic pump manufacturing activity, the founders should demonstrate adequate equity capitalization commensurate with industrial operating risk.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the initial share capital as stated in the Articles of Association is fully subscribed, and cash contributions are deposited at the depositary bank under Article L.223-7 of the French Commercial Code. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office is established at 26 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France, within the jurisdiction of the Paris Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, and may be transferred by simple partner decision. RESOLVED FURTHER, that Mr. Édouard Silvertrade is appointed Gérant, with full powers of administration, representation, banking signatory authority, and power to complete all regulatory and environmental licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (mandatory for in-kind contributions exceeding EUR 30,000 or real property contributions) or all partners acting by private deed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the French-language Articles of Association (statuts) setting forth legal form SARL, corporate name, registered office, corporate object comprising the design, manufacture, maintenance and trade of cryogenic pumps for LNG and other cryogenic fluids, duration, share capital, share allocation, management powers, and transfer restrictions. Appoint a commissaire aux apports if required and attach his valuation report to the Articles. Ensure all partners sign personally or by valid proxy; date the deed and certify conformity with the French legal publicity rules.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association in French
Valuation report of commissaire aux apports, if applicable
Proxy forms for partners signing by representation
Identity documents of all partners
Identity and proof of address of the proposed Gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the commercial registry identifies an irregularity in the Articles, convene a partner decision to amend the relevant clauses and re-execute the deed; if the defect is formal only, file an acte rectificatif before registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocked Deposit of Share Capital and Bank Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary, non-signatory bank account in the name of the company in formation, e.g., 'SARL [Name] en formation'. Deposit the full cash portion of the subscribed capital into this blocked account. Obtain from the bank the mandatory attestation de dépôt des fonds certifying that the funds are blocked and will be released only upon registration or restitution to subscribers if registration fails. In-kind contributions are delivered on execution of the Articles and do not pass through the blocked account.
required_dossiers: Temporary bank account application
Subscriber and capital contribution schedule
Identity documents of subscribers
Copy of the signed Articles of Association
Bank attestation de dépôt des fonds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses to issue a deposit certificate, obtain a certificate from a notaire or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; if the subscribed funds are incomplete, collect the missing contributions and re-certify before filing the registration dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales authorized in the legal publicity area of the registered office (department of Paris).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the mandatory notice of constitution containing the proposed corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, Gérant identity, and the court where registration will be sought. Obtain the original issue or an attestation de parution from the legal gazette, and retain the proof of publication to annex to the M0 filing dossier.
required_dossiers: Avis de constitution text
Copy of the planned M0 declaration for cross-checking
Proof of publication / attestation de parution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice contains incomplete or incorrect mandatory information, publish a corrective legal notice before the filing; if the error is discovered after registration, petition the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for an order of rectification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing through the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique platform; the dossier is transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of Paris and to INSEE.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online M0 application for creation of a SARL, select the relevant legal form, and upload all required supporting documents. Indicate the principal place of activity, including the physical plant address if different from the registered office, and supply all manager and beneficial-owner information. Pay the official filing fees electronically. The Guichet unique performs formal control and forwards the file to the competent commercial registry for legal registration.
required_dossiers: Completed M0 / CERFA 11661 form
Signed Articles of Association
Bank deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt des fonds)
Proof of legal announcement publication
Identity documents of Gérant and beneficial owners
Beneficial-owner declaration (Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
Justificatif de jouissance or domiciliation agreement for the registered office
Power of attorney if filing through a legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Guichet unique raises a non-conformity, respond within the prescribed 15-day period by amending or supplementing the dossier; if the file is rejected, rectify defects and resubmit; if the rejection is contested, file an appeal before the competent judicial authority within 30 days or re-file after correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the RNE and Issuance of Legal Existence Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris and INSEE.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the registry validates the dossier, the company is inscribed in the Registre National des Entreprises and receives an extrait Kbis / avis de situation au RNE, SIREN and SIRET numbers, and the applicable NAF/APE code 28.13Z. The company acquires legal personality from the date of registration. Verify the accuracy of the registered details and keep the Kbis at the registered office for commercial and banking transactions.
required_dossiers: Acknowledgement receipt of Guichet unique filing
Copy of the validated M0 declaration
Registry-generated Kbis / RNE statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis is not delivered in time or contains incorrect data, request rectification by the Greffe or INSEE; while awaiting correction, use the official filing acknowledgement as provisional proof of legal existence for bank and administrative purposes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Corporate and Regulatory Opening Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gérant, statutory partners, DREETS for occupational controls, DREAL for ICPE matters, and tax/social authorities via automatic RNE synchronization.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a permanent operating bank account in the company's name, set up the signature rights for the Gérant, and prepare the full payment rails for letter of credit and SWIFT wire transactions. Open and paginate the mandatory legal registers, issue any share certificates or records, and file a register of shares. Confirm tax and social security registrations have been synchronized through the RNE; if the manufacturing plant qualifies as an ICPE, file the declaration, registration or authorization application with the DREAL before commencing operations. Conduct workplace occupational safety inspections and fire safety clearances as required.
required_dossiers: Extrait Kbis / RNE statement
Register of partner decisions and minutes
Share register or share certificates
Bank account opening confirmation
ICPE declaration / registration receipt, if applicable
DREETS occupational inspection acknowledgement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax or social registrations are not reflected, request a follow-up through the signatory declarations; if an ICPE dossier is queried, supplement the missing technical or environmental information within the administrative deadline or request a regional prefectural arbitration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) under the Préfet de département, with INERIS as technical support for cryogenic risks; DREETS for occupational safety and physical workplace licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Acte d'exploitation / récépissé de déclaration or arrêté préfectoral d'enregistrement or d'autorisation d'une Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) for the industrial manufacture of cryogenic liquid pumps and associated storage or use of cryogenic fluids.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL / Inspection des Installations Classées; environmental assessment oversight by the Autorité Environnementale (Mission Régionale d'Autorité Environnementale).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Classification depends on plant thresholds: small mechanical assembly workshops are commonly 'Déclaration (D)'; sites storing or using LNG or other cryogenic flammable fluids above ICPE thresholds are subject to 'Enregistrement (E)' or 'Autorisation (A)'. A full environmental impact assessment is mandatory for all Autorisation cases and may also be required in Enregistrement cases under the screening thresholds of Code de l'environnement Article R.122-2 and Annex II of Directive 2011/92/EU.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance required for wastewater discharges, including pH 5.5-9.5, temperature below 30°C, and applicable COD and TSS concentration limits under the relevant ICPE arrêté and any municipal sewer agreement; VOC emissions from surface treatment, painting, or degreasing must meet the solvent management and abatement requirements of Directive 2010/75/EU and the implementing French arrêté, including respect of the applicable VOC concentration limit where treatment is required; cryogenic gas venting must be minimized through closed recovery, vapor return systems, and emergency flare controls to prevent atmospheric and safety hazards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued after inspection by the SDIS (Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours), covering cryogenic-specific hazards such as cold burns, oxygen-enriched atmospheres, and gas dispersion; structural load and blast-zone verification for storage vessels and pressure-transfer areas; emergency evacuation and internal operation plan verified; and an occupational workplace clearance by DREETS confirming safe working conditions, electrical conformity, and prevention of physical and chemical hazards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP); taxpayer portal: impots.gouv.fr; business registration via the INPI guichet unique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; direct VAT and corporate income tax (IS) compliance handled by the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) of the registered office; customs and EORI procedures administered by the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Within one month of incorporation, file the acte constitutif via the INPI guichet unique to obtain INSEE-assigned SIREN (9 digits) and SIRET (14 digits); the SARL's APE/NAF code is set to 28.13Z 'Fabrication d'autres pompes et compresseurs', corresponding to ISIC 2813. The DGFiP simultaneously issues the intra-community VAT number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire) in the format FR + 2-digit control key + 9-digit SIREN. A non-resident manufacturer creating a French permanent establishment must file form 1447-C-E (initial registration) with the local SIE within 60 days of commencing business; amendments and cessation are filed on forms 1447-SD and 1447-M respectively. The exporter must separately obtain an EORI number (FR + SIREN) from DGDDI before lodging export declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The SARL is by default subject to Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS) at 25%; a reduced 15% rate applies to the first €42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying small businesses (Art. 44 sexies-0 A CGI). France applies the territorialité principle: only profits derived from activities carried on in France are taxable (Art. 209 CGI); tax residence is determined by registered office or effective place of management in France. No general tax-exempt zone applies in Metropolitan France; EU outermost overseas regions are outside this engine's scope.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Pass-through election to Impôt sur le Revenu (IR) is available without prior consent to SARL de famille (Art. 239 bis AA CGI) and, by petition to the tax administration, to small SARLs meeting cumulative conditions (fewer than 50 employees, turnover ≤ €10 million, all or part of the partners being natural persons) under Art. 239 bis A CGI; the IR option runs for 5 years and is renewable. Conversely, a family SARL can elect IS. A French-resident parent holding ≥95% may include the SARL in the fiscal integration regime (Art. 223 A CGI). France transposes ATAD anti-hybrid rules (Art. 209 VII CGI); no elective hybrid-mismatch or US-style check-the-box exists, and any switch between IS and IR is treated as a deemed disposal of assets and is audit-sensitive.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: TVA — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (French VAT), governed by CGI Arts. 256 to 289 quinquies, implementing Directive 2006/112/EC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT registration threshold for an established manufacturer: registration is mandatory from the first taxable supply in France. The franchise en base de TVA (Art. 293 B CGI) applies only to micro-enterprises below €91,900 annual turnover for goods and is in any case unsuitable for a manufacturer claiming zero-rated exports, as it forfeits input VAT recovery. Intra-EU distance sales of goods to French consumers trigger the €10,000 single EU-wide OSS threshold; B2B supplies to French customers by a non-established supplier fall under the reverse charge and do not require French registration; import VAT is payable at customs clearance on imported components and finished goods.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is implementing a compulsory dematerialized e-invoicing and e-reporting reform coordinated by DGFiP. VAT-taxable persons established in France must receive e-invoices in a structured format and transmit transaction and payment data (e-reporting) in (near) real time through an accredited Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire (PDP) interconnected to the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF). Following the 2025 simplification of the original schedule: e-invoice issuance becomes mandatory for large enterprises and mid-caps on 1 September 2026 and for SMEs/VSEs on 1 September 2027; e-reporting of B2B and B2C transaction data applies from the same dates. Accepted data formats are UBL, UN/CEFACT Cross-Industry Invoice and Factur-X (EN 16931 compliance). No fiscal digital stamping or physical invoice seal is used as in MENA jurisdictions; compliance is enforced through validated PDP cycles, refusal and acceptance flows, and transmission receipts routed via the PPF API gateway (no human-readable hard-copy mandate).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of LNG cryogenic pumps, spare parts and accessories to a non-EU buyer qualifies for exemption with the right to deduct input VAT (effective 0% export rate under Art. 262-I-1° CGI), provided the physical export occurs within 90 days of the delivery date and the exporter proves, by documentary evidence, that the goods left French and EU customs territory under a single supply contract (BOI-TVA-CHAMP-30-20-20). Direct exports, triangular and chain exports, and exports on consignment to non-EU destinations are eligible. Services directly related to the exported goods (e.g., commissioning supervision) are zero-rated; standalone offshore engineering or consultancy services fall outside the scope of French VAT under Arts. 259 to 259 B CGI, subject to B2B place-of-supply rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DAU (Document Administratif Unique) — the electronic export declaration lodged through the DELTA-X customs system, showing the exporter's EORI number, the goods nomenclature code (NC 8413.70 for pumps) and the definitive export code in Box 37
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR (official transport document evidencing departure from EU customs territory to the non-EU destination)
Commercial invoice (facture d'exportation) stating Incoterms, marks and numbers, HS code and the 0% VAT justification
Packing list / weight and volume note for the consignment
Inward remittance certificate or SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of the foreign-currency proceeds; for letter-of-credit transactions, each drawing under the LC must be traceable
Export contract / irrevocable purchase order from the non-EU importer (amount, currency, Incoterms, payment terms)
Transport insurance certificate (optional but strongly recommended for audit substantiation)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is subject to strict documentary audit: if the physical export is not completed within 90 days of delivery or the evidentiary bundle is incomplete, the sale is reclassified as a taxable domestic supply and the SARL is reassessed on unreported French VAT (retrospective clawback), together with denial of input VAT recovery on related purchases. Penalties escalate under Art. 1729 CGI: 40% for intentional misdeclaration (mauvaise foi), 80% for fraudulent maneuvers (manœuvres frauduleuses) and for abuse of law, plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.2% (Art. 1727 CGI). A fraudulent zero-rating claim extends the standard assessment limitation period from 3 to 10 years (Art. L. 169 LPF) and can trigger personal liability of the SARL's directors under Art. L. 267 LPF where they knowingly organized the company's insolvency or fraudulent non-collection of VAT.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, operating within the Eurosystem framework of the European Central Bank; foreign-exchange, payment-services, sanctions and capital-movement compliance also involves the French Treasury, the Direction Générale du Trésor, the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution, the Autorité des Marchés Financiers and, for customs matters, the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible for ordinary current-account and capital-account transactions. France generally imposes no exchange-control approval for capital contributions, shareholder loans, dividends, royalties, interest, trade payments or liquidation proceeds. Transfers remain subject to EU and French sanctions, anti-money-laundering, counter-terrorist-financing, tax, customs, beneficial-ownership and financial-reporting rules. A French SARL may receive and remit foreign currency through regulated payment institutions or credit institutions, subject to bank due diligence and transaction-purpose verification. Dividend and interest remittances may trigger French withholding tax, subject to domestic exemptions, applicable tax treaties, the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive, interest and royalty rules, beneficial-ownership requirements and anti-abuse provisions. Foreign direct investment screening may apply to acquisitions or investments involving activities affecting public order, public security or national defence; ordinary cryogenic-pump manufacturing requires case-specific screening rather than automatic approval. Certain LNG, cryogenic, industrial or dual-use products may also require export-control classification and authorization before shipment.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general statutory requirement for exporters to surrender export proceeds to a French bank, no general mandatory conversion ratio and no universal statutory deadline for converting foreign-currency export receipts into euros. Export receipts may generally be retained in foreign-currency accounts or converted at the company's discretion, subject to contractual bank terms, accounting in euros, tax and customs records, sanctions controls, anti-money-laundering monitoring and any applicable balance-of-payments or statistical reporting. Export documentation, commercial invoices, transport evidence, customs declarations, purchase orders and proof of receipt should be retained under French accounting and tax record-retention rules. Cash movements of EUR 10,000 or more across the EU external border are subject to customs declaration requirements, and banks may impose internal documentation thresholds or reporting requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. and the relevant Crédit Agricole regional cooperative bank
Banque Populaire and Caisse d'Epargne banking network operated through BPCE S.A.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for operational payment accounts and treasury sub-accounts; Low as a substitute for a French bank capital-deposit account, regulated trade-finance provider or complex industrial treasury bank. An offshore digital EMI cannot lawfully provide French banking services unless it is authorized under the applicable EU passporting framework or otherwise licensed in France. EMI safeguarding accounts are not bank deposit accounts and generally do not provide lending, bank guarantees, documentary letters of credit or statutory capital-certification functions. Use of an EMI should be limited to permitted payment services after verification of its EEA authorization, passporting status, safeguarding model, IBAN jurisdiction, sanctions coverage, transaction limits, account-closure policy and ability to support corporate beneficial-owner and industrial trade documentation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance of directors is not generally mandated by French law for every corporate account opening. Remote onboarding may be permitted where the institution can reliably identify the legal representative and beneficial owners using compliant electronic identification, qualified signatures, video verification and documentary checks. Banks may nevertheless require an in-person meeting, original or certified documents, French-resident signatory access, a local address, a French telephone number, source-of-funds evidence or a branch visit for non-resident-owned entities, complex ownership structures, high-risk jurisdictions, unusual payment corridors or elevated sanctions and export-control exposure. Capital escrow arrangements commonly require a bank-approved formation package and may require the legal representative or authorized adviser to complete enhanced verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque, layered or nominee ownership, inability to identify the ultimate beneficial owner or inconsistency between the articles, shareholder register, corporate registry and ownership chart.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Recent Kbis extract or equivalent registration evidence; signed articles of association; complete ownership and control chart to natural persons; passports and residential-address evidence for all beneficial owners, directors and authorized signatories; shareholder register; corporate documents for parent entities; notarized or certified translations where requested; UBO declaration; explanation of control rights and a board authorization.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder or director, remote management, no established French operating footprint or use of a registered-office provider.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: French registered-office agreement; lease, warehouse or manufacturing-site evidence; business plan; staffing plan; supplier and customer contracts; expected French payroll, tax and customs activity; director mandate; local accountant or corporate-service-provider engagement; group organizational chart; explanation of why France is the commercial and manufacturing hub.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Industrial activity involving LNG, cryogenic equipment, pressure systems, dual-use technology, restricted destinations or potentially controlled end users.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Product catalogue and technical specifications; HS and dual-use classification analysis; end-use and end-user statements; sanctions-screening methodology; export-control compliance policy; customer and distributor due-diligence files; destination-country matrix; applicable French or EU export authorizations; customs registrations; evidence of technical and product-safety compliance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large or unexplained inbound capital, shareholder loans, intercompany transfers or rapid movement of funds after incorporation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed capital-subscription documents; shareholder or board resolutions; bank statements showing source of funds; audited financial statements of the funding entity; tax-residence certificates; loan agreement and repayment schedule; transfer-pricing support; funds-flow diagram; commercial rationale; confirmation that funds are not proceeds of sanctioned, criminal or undisclosed third-party activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected payment flows inconsistent with the stated business model, including high-value wires, third-party payments, circular transactions or payments through high-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve-month cash-flow forecast; customer and supplier concentration analysis; sample invoices and purchase orders; Incoterms and shipping routes; approved payment matrix; third-party-payment policy; sanctions and adverse-media screening records; reconciliation procedures; transaction-monitoring escalation policy; explanation of each high-risk corridor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax, customs or regulatory documentation gaps, including missing VAT registration, EORI information, import arrangements or licenses required for the product.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SIREN and SIRET evidence; Kbis extract; French VAT registration or registration plan; EORI number; customs representation agreement; import and export procedures; product conformity documentation; pressure-equipment and machinery compliance assessment; insurance certificates; relevant industrial, environmental or sectoral permits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse media, politically exposed person status, sanctions exposure, corruption indicators or links to state-owned entities in sensitive jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent compliance-screening report; PEP disclosure and wealth/source-of-wealth statement; sanctions and restricted-party screening results; beneficial-ownership certification; anti-bribery and anti-corruption policy; intermediary due diligence; government-contract documentation; legal opinion or external compliance memorandum where necessary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inability to demonstrate a credible treasury-control environment for a medium-risk enhanced industrial business.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury policy; dual-authorization matrix; bank-signatory mandate; segregation-of-duties chart; payment approval workflow; monthly bank-reconciliation process; FX and counterparty limits; fraud-prevention controls; cyber-security policy; independent accounting engagement; internal audit or management review plan.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route euro funding through SEPA Credit Transfer where the sending and receiving institutions participate; use SWIFT customer credit transfer for non-SEPA currencies or non-EEA banks. Name the French SARL as beneficiary, use its exact registered name and IBAN, and identify the transfer as paid-in capital, capital contribution, share-premium contribution, shareholder loan or intercompany funding. France does not impose a general central-bank pre-approval requirement for ordinary inbound capital. The receiving bank should receive the subscription agreement, shareholder or board resolution, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth evidence, funding-entity financial statements, ownership chart, loan agreement if applicable, tax-residence information and the expected funds-flow schedule before settlement. French banks may request transaction-purpose information and may apply their own payment-purpose coding; France does not have a single universal statutory purpose-code system equivalent to regimes that require a central-bank code for every corporate wire. Funds intended for statutory share capital should be sent to a capital-deposit account and should not be treated as operational cash until the bank issues the certificate of deposit and the incorporation or capital-increase formalities are completed. Maintain a payment audit trail, reconcile the bank statement to the general ledger and document any conversion from foreign currency into euros under the bank's execution rate.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible euro suppliers; use SWIFT customer credit transfer, commonly represented by an MT103 or its ISO 20022 successor, for non-SEPA payments. For documentary trade, use an irrevocable commercial letter of credit subject to UCP 600, preferably confirmed where country or bank risk warrants confirmation. Documentary collections may be structured under URC 522. Confirm the beneficiary, bank coordinates, sanctions status, end user, product classification, Incoterms, shipping documents, customs evidence, insurance and invoice before release. For imports, align payment release with the purchase order, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, certificate of origin, inspection evidence and customs declaration. For exports, retain proof of shipment, export declaration, end-user statement and payment reconciliation. Specify OUR, SHA or BEN charge allocation, establish dual approval for high-value payments and prohibit third-party settlement unless documented and pre-approved. Banks may reject or hold payments involving sanctioned countries, controlled goods, unclear end users, unusual routing or incomplete trade documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EUR/foreign-currency forwards with an EU-authorized bank or investment firm, documented under an ISDA or equivalent master agreement and supported by a demonstrable underlying commercial exposure.

Non-deliverable forwards for currencies that are not freely deliverable or where local-market restrictions make physical settlement impractical; NDFs are generally settled by net cash difference and remain subject to counterparty eligibility, EMIR, MiFID II, sanctions and bank suitability requirements.

Currency swaps and cross-currency swaps for recurring funding, intercompany loans or balance-sheet currency mismatches, subject to ISDA documentation, collateral terms, EMIR reporting and appropriate accounting treatment.

FX options, collars and option-based hedges where the bank has completed appropriateness and documentation requirements; avoid speculative or leveraged structures unrelated to identifiable commercial exposures.

Hedges should be approved under a board-level treasury policy specifying permitted currencies, counterparties, maturities, hedge ratios, collateral thresholds, valuation, accounting treatment, confirmation, independent reconciliation and termination controls.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Convening and holding of the annual ordinary meeting (AGO) of SARL associates to approve the annual accounts, management report, and profit-allocation resolution.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate records: statutory minute book; no filing to a supervisory authority is required for the meeting itself.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company by 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: An interested person may petition the President of the Commercial Court for an injunction with a daily penalty up to EUR 150 per month of delay; continuing failure engages the manager's civil liability and may justify court-appointed temporary administration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of the approved annual accounts (comptes annuels), management report, auditor's report (if required), and profit-allocation resolution with the Registry of the Commercial Court for attachment to the RCS file.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce (Registre du commerce et des sociétés).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the AGO and in any event no later than seven months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year entity, by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-ordered injunction with daily penalty up to EUR 150; manager liable to a fifth-class fine up to EUR 1,500 (legal-person fine up to EUR 10,000); long-term non-filing exposes the company to administrative strike-off from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax declaration and financial statement components (liasse fiscale: Cerfa no. 2065-SD and relevant 2031/2053-2059 series) reporting taxable income and balance-sheet data.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP) — EDI/EFI electronic tax filing platform.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year ending 31 December, filing is due on the second business day following 1 May (3 May or 5 May depending on the calendar); for non-calendar years, within three months of the fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.5% per month plus graduated late-filing penalties (5% to 20% by level of default) assessed by the DGFiP; failure to file the balance-sheet exhibit also blocks any claim for carry-forward relief.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaration of beneficial owners (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs, DBE) update and contemporaneous recording of share transfer or part-cession in the securities-movements register.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce (RCS) for the DBE amendment; statutory register maintained at the corporate seat for the transfer record.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after any modification of beneficial ownership or any SARL share transfer; no stand-alone national UBO annual filing exists absent a change, but compliance is confirmed in the annual meeting minutes.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Managers are exposed to a fine up to EUR 7,500 (EUR 37,500 for the legal entity) for failure to update the DBE; an unregistered transfer may be declared unopposable to the SARL and to third parties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory for a SARL when, at fiscal year-end, at least two of three thresholds are exceeded: balance-sheet total EUR 4.0 million; net turnover excluding tax EUR 8.0 million; average number of employees 50. Appointment may also be requested by associates representing at least 10% of capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP under the Plan Comptable Général, transposing Directive 2013/34/EU; IFRS/EU-endorsed standards apply to consolidated accounts of listed entities, while statutory individual accounts of the SARL must remain in French GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France requires an up-to-date declaration of effective beneficiaries at registration and within 30 days of any modification resulting, inter alia, from a share transfer. At the annual meeting, the gérant reconciles the member list and securities-movements register, confirms current percentage holdings, arranges any DBE amendment if a shareholder or indirect control has changed, and records an attestation of no change in the minutes when applicable.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members and securities movements (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of Directors and manager decisions (registre des délibérations de gérance/livre des décisions)
Minute Book of annual general meetings and collective decisions (procès-verbaux et résolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 110-380 (typical commercial domiciliation service at the registered office address plus mail handling; France does not require a separately compensated registered agent for a SARL).
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,400-21,600 (typical market range for a small-to-medium manufacturing SARL; the exact certified-audit fee varies with group structure, inventory valuation, intercompany transactions, and internal-control maturity).
